import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 12))
fig.suptitle('Hundebestand Analyse', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Dog age distribution
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax1.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_xlabel('Hundealter', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Verteilung nach Hundealter', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution by Kreis (district)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
kreis_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(kreis_counts))
ax2.barh(range(len(kreis_counts)), kreis_counts.values, color=colors, alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(kreis_counts)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(kreis_counts.index, fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Verteilung nach Kreis', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Top dog breeds
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
ax3.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color='coral', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax3.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Anzahl', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Top 10 Hunderassen', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Owner age distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(owner_age_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(owner_age_counts.values, 
                                     labels=owner_age_counts.index,
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_pie,
                                     startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Verteilung nach Besitzeralter', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
